lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਠਾਂਢੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam kee gat thaa(n)dhee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਕਾਢੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan simrit saadhoo jan khojat khojat kaadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Searching, searching the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the Holy Saints have realized this. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚ ਅਰੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਤੌ ਫਿਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: siv bira(n)ch ar i(n)dr lok taa mahi jalatau phiriaa ||
lines.translation: In the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and Indra, I wandered around, burning up with envy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar suaamee bhae seetal dookh darad bhram hiriaa ||1||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, I became cool and calm; my pains, sorrows and doubts are gone. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤਰਿਓ ਪੁਰਾਤਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo tario puraatan navatan bhagat bhaai har devaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever has been saved in the past or the present, was saved through loving devotional worship of the Divine Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੫੨॥੭੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh jeeu milai sa(n)t jan sevaa ||2||52||75||
lines.translation: This is Nanak's prayer: O Dear God, please let me serve the humble Saints. ||2||52||75||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihave a(n)mrit gun har gaau ||
lines.translation: O my tongue, sing the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਚਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har bol kathaa sun har kee ucharahu prabh ko naau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, listen to the Lord's Sermon, and chant God's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ratan dhan sa(n)chahu man tan laavahu bhaau ||
lines.translation: So gather in the jewel, the wealth of the Lord's Name; love God with your mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aan bibhoot mithiaa kar maanahu saachaa ihai suaau ||1||
lines.translation: You must realize that all other wealth is false; this alone is the true purpose of life. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan mukat ko daataa ekas siu liv laau ||
lines.translation: He is the Giver of the soul, the breath of life and liberation; lovingly tune in to the One and Only Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥੨॥੫੩॥੭੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee saranaaee det sagal apiaau ||2||53||76||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have entered His Sanctuary; He gives sustenance to all. ||2||53||76||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hotee nahee kavan kachh karanee ||
lines.translation: I cannot do anything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੈ ਓਟ ਪਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihai ot paaee mil sa(n)tah gopaal ek kee saranee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have taken this Support, meeting the Saints; I have entered the Sanctuary of the One Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch dokh chhidr iaa tan mahi bikhai biaadh kee karanee ||
lines.translation: The five wicked enemies are within this body; they lead the mortal to practice evil and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸ ਅਪਾਰ ਦਿਨਸ ਗਣਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਲੁ ਜਰਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aas apaar dinas gan raakhe grasat jaat bal jaranee ||1||
lines.translation: He has infinite hope, but his days are numbered, and old age is sapping his strength. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਭੈ ਹਰਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anaathah naath daiaal sukh saagar sarab dokh bhai haranee ||
lines.translation: He is the Help of the helpless, the Merciful Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of all pains and fears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੪॥੭੭॥
lines.transliteration: man baa(n)chhat chitavat naanak daas pekh jeevaa prabh charanee ||2||54||77||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak longs for this blessing, that he may live, gazing upon the Feet of God. ||2||54||77||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: pheeke har ke naam bin saad ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, flavors are tasteless and insipid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit ras keeratan har gaaeeai ahinis pooran naad ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Sing the Sweet Ambrosial Praises of the Lord's Kirtan; day and night, the Sound-current of the Naad will resonate and resound. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarat saa(n)t mahaa sukh paaeeai mit jaahi sagal bikhaad ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, total peace and bliss are obtained, and all sorrows are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵਹੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har laabh saadhasa(n)g paaeeai ghar lai aavahu laad ||1||
lines.translation: The profit of the Lord, Har, Har, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; so load it and bring it on home. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਜਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh te ooch ooch te oocho a(n)t nahee marajaad ||
lines.translation: He is the Highest of all, the Highest of the high; His celestial ecomony has no limit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੫੫॥੭੮॥
lines.transliteration: baran na saakau naanak mahimaa pekh rahe bisamaad ||2||55||78||
lines.translation: Nanak cannot even express His Glorious Grandeur; gazing upon Him, he is wonder-struck. ||2||55||78||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਓ ਸੁਨਨ ਪੜਨ ਕਉ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaio sunan paRan kau baanee ||
lines.translation: The mortal came to hear and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam visaar lagahi an laalach birathaa janam paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: But he has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he has become attached to other temptations. His life is totally worthless! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਝੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਥੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: samajh achet chet man mere kathee sa(n)tan akath kahaanee ||
lines.translation: O my unconscious mind, become conscious and figure it out; the Saints speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਭੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: laabh laihu har ridai araadhahu chhutakai aavan jaanee ||1||
lines.translation: So gather in your profits - worship and adore the Lord within your heart; your coming and going in reincarnation shall end. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam sakat siaanap tumhree dehi ta naam vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: Efforts, powers and clever tricks are Yours; if You bless me with them, I repeat Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੬॥੭੯॥
lines.transliteration: seee bhagat bhagat se laage naanak jo prabh bhaanee ||2||56||79||
lines.translation: They alone are devotees, and they alone are attached to devotional worship, O Nanak, who are pleasing to God. ||2||56||79||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanava(n)t naam ke vanajaare ||
lines.translation: Those who deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are wealthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)jhee karahu naam dhan khaatahu gur kaa sabad veechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: So become a partner with them, and earn the wealth of the Naam. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
